name: 54724 · Bloomer, WI
findings: ZIP 54724 (Bloomer) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54724 (Bloomer) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 54724 (Bloomer) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).
